# CallAudit.co

> CallAudit.co is an AI-native call auditing platform that analyzes call transcripts for quality, compliance, outcomes, sentiment, coaching opportunities, churn risk, and revenue signals.

Canonical website: https://callaudit.co/
Pricing: https://callaudit.co/pricing
Sitemap: https://callaudit.co/sitemap.xml
Language: English

## Primary capabilities

- Bulk upload existing call transcripts without waiting for API integration.
- Connect a call platform for continuous transcript analysis.
- Score calls against custom quality and compliance criteria.
- Link every score, flag, and insight to supporting transcript evidence.
- Detect buying signals, churn risk, coaching gaps, and customer outcomes.

## How it works

1. Connect a call platform or upload existing transcripts in bulk.
2. Analyze every transcript for quality, compliance, sentiment, outcomes, and revenue signals.
3. Score calls consistently using evidence linked to the exact transcript moment.
4. Act on coaching opportunities, risk, customer experience issues, and commercial signals.

## Key facts

- Traditional QA sampling commonly reviews about 5% of calls; CallAudit.co is designed to analyze 100% of available call transcripts.
- Existing transcripts can be analyzed before any real-time API integration.
- The first 100 call minutes can be audited free.
- High-volume and live analysis are available through a custom plan.
